title: SEVI: Safe Evidential Real-World Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.31829v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world reinforcement learning has enabled contact-rich manipulation tasks to be trained directly on physical robots, but unsafe interactions during online learning remain a key barrier to practical deployment. We propose Safe Evidential Real-World Reinforcement Learning (SEVI), a framework for reliability-aware safety intervention during real-world policy learning. SEVI introduces an Evidential Safety Critic that estimates both future constraint-violation risk and epistemic uncertainty in a single forward pass. During online learning, SEVI evaluates each task-policy action before execution; if the action is predicted to be unsafe or the prediction is insufficiently supported by evidence, SEVI overrides it with an offline-trained recovery policy that guides the robot toward a lower-risk region. translated_title: SEVI：安全的证据式真实世界强化学习
translated_abstract: 真实世界强化学习已经使富接触操作任务能够直接在物理机器人上进行训练，但在在线学习过程中的不安全交互仍然是实际部署的关键障碍。我们提出了安全证据式真实世界强化学习，这是一个在真实世界策略学习过程中进行可靠性感知安全干预的框架。SEVI引入了一个证据式安全评论家，能够在单次前向传播中同时估计未来的约束违反风险和认知不确定性。在在线学习期间，SEVI会在执行前评估任务策略的每个动作；如果预测该动作不安全，或该预测缺乏足够的证据支持，SEVI将用一个离线训练的恢复策略覆盖该动作，引导机器人前往风险更低的区域。我们在分布内和分布偏移条件下，于两个模拟操作任务和一个真实世界的USB插入任务上对SEVI进行了评估。
tldr: SEVI提出证据式安全评论家框架，在单次前向传播中同时估计约束违反风险与认知不确定性，并在真实世界策略学习中对不安全或证据不足的动作进行离线恢复策略干预，从而实现安全的真实世界强化学习。
en_tdlr: SEVI introduces an Evidential Safety Critic that jointly estimates constraint-violation risk and epistemic uncertainty in a single forward pass, overriding unsafe or insufficiently-evidenced actions with an offline-trained recovery policy to enable safe real-world reinforcement learning.
